text:
I'm sorry your monstera has declined like that. At 20 days since delivery you're inside the 30-day guarantee, and stem rot plus losing half its leaves counts as significant decline, so you should be eligible for one free replacement of the same plant (or store credit if it's out of stock).

To claim, go to "My Orders" before day 30 and submit at least two photos (the whole plant and a close-up of the rot). A Plant Care Specialist will review within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back. Note that the guarantee doesn't cover pests introduced after delivery, deliberate neglect, or repotting into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days, so those could affect the outcome.
